versions.content: Specify a name pattern or a blueprint value in blueprints For each blueprint, a namePattern or a blueprintValue shall be specified if the shortName respectively a symbol is not fixed but intended to be defined when ob- jects are derived from a blueprint. This is used to verify the appropriate naming of the derived objects ([constr_2553]).
